name: stale_unit_price_from_large_variant
author: plan-agent
cheat: The correct variant v0001 is in the cart, but the line captured the price of the large variant (24650) because the agent switched size after the price element had rendered; totals are internally consistent with the wrong price, so the shopper is overcharged 600 agorot. A judge that verifies variant, quantity and coupon code but never re-derives unitPrice from the catalogue accepts it.
